question: Among the following, which contains the lowest amount of sugar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Potato.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The sugar content of food items per 100 ****gm:**

 
• Apple contains 10 grams of sugar per 100 grams.
 
• Mango contains 14 grams of sugar per 100 grams.
 
• **Potato contains 0.8 grams of sugar per 100 grams.**
 
• Banana contains 12 grams of sugar per 100 grams.
